title: with no intentd running, intent sync --to-store carries no hand edit to a cover, because nothing records the cover as touched
body:
Found by dc on 2026-09-24 in the 3.2.1 doc audit, driven in a scratch project with no intentd running, on the pair at `4c687eaad`.

Seen: after a hand edit to `## Objective` in a thread's `info.md`, `intent sync --to-store` (unscoped) exits 0 with "note: no thread the store already holds differs on disk, so this restore overwrites nothing", and `intent st show` still reads "_(not yet written)_". `carry_info_round_trip` (`ingest.rs:1300-1340`) reads a cover back only when the file index recorded it as touched (`touched.contains(rel)`), and with no watcher nothing records the touch. So the Objective and Context round-trip that `views.rs:474` and the in-essentials skill describe runs only while intentd is running; for a CLI-only user the working door is `intent set <ID> objective|context`. (The scoped form, `intent sync --to-store <ID>`, did carry an edit in vc's subagent's drive, and folds the body while doing so -- 0568.)

Expected: the verb a remedy names for carrying a cover edit carries it, with or without intentd.

Disposition: vc, 2026-09-24 -- one family with 0559, 0556 and 0568; its disposition follows hv's ruling on that family.
